examples: Watch the api and web sessions side by side while both run tests.
Keep a plain shell in a second pane beside an agent.
how_to: Click + at the end of the tab strip to open another session in a new tab.
Open the components menu (grid icon in the drawer bar) and choose arrange in columns, rows or a grid.
Drag tabs to move them between panes. On a phone the panes become a swipeable strip.

name: Terminal panes and tabs
summary: split a session's terminal into multiple panes and tabs, arranged in a grid you control.
where: Open a session: its tabs run along the top of the terminal.
The + after the last tab adds another; the components icon arranges them.
